description: This Java class 'DataUtils' provides utility methods for manipulating and converting data related to postal codes, weights, and measurements within the context of a sales management system. It includes methods for trimming postal codes, converting weights between units, and converting measurements between inches and centimeters, considering store-specific measure units.

classes.name: DataUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for data manipulation specific to postal codes, weights, and measurements.

methods.name: trimPostalCode
methods.description: Removes all characters except alphanumeric from the postal code string.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Converts weight values between pounds and kilograms based on store settings and measurement base unit.

methods.name: getMeasure
methods.description: Converts measurements between inches and centimeters based on store settings and measurement base unit.
